name: Suibara (Japan)
description: A red field charged at the centre with the Suibara town emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom with two horn-like strokes, enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Suibara in Niigata Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-04-01.

features.role: Suibara town emblem — a ring open at the bottom with two horn-like strokes, enclosing a stylised character
